g.text: Three-tier design with strict separation of concerns
Queued batch via sendBeacon on page unload
Auto-exported to OpenAPI spec for frontend types
Routes stay clean: no try/except boilerplate
No permissive policies (all access via backend)
MIME validation, size limits per bucket
Refresh: httpOnly cookie, restored on app init
Category, school, price, date range, food
Reason labels: "Based on your interests", etc.
Event form, promotion upsell, AI generation
Rule: useState for UI state first -> useReducer for complex logic -> Context for cross-component -> Zustand for server-synced global data
Rule: Stores are idempotent (skip fetch if data loaded). Optimistic updates for save/unsave with background sync.
Shared Infrastructure: apiClient.ts (fetch wrapper + auth) | trackingService.ts | storageService.ts | uploadService.ts | preferencesStorage.ts | 50+ shared UI components
Constants: 22 event categories | 12 interest groups | school list | language packs | filter options | promotion packages
Views: Grid, Calendar, Map | localStorage: theme, email cache, profile cache, viewMode, language only
App Shell: TopNav (school selector, lang, dark mode, auth) | Sidebar (compact 12px -> hover 180px, nav links) | ProtectedRoute (role gating)
Green = general | Orange = recommendation/experiment | Red-orange = admin-only (get_admin_user) | Purple = AI-powered
55+ total endpoints | Pydantic request/response validation | OpenAPI spec auto-generated
When to use: stateful deps, config, DI needed
user_service — CRUD, profile, list, admin lookup
Thin DB wrappers — call get_sb() at invocation time
Online reads pre-computed | Offline full pipeline
Multi-strategy blending with dynamic weights and diversity reranking
Assignment: SHA256(experiment:user_id) -> deterministic bucket (no randomness, no DB lookup)
Tracking: ab_test_events table (impression, click) | Metric: CTR = clicks / impressions per variant
Admin dashboard: GET /ab/metrics -> { control: {impressions, clicks, ctr}, treatment: {...} }
Leave-one-out evaluation across users with 5+ interactions
Metrics: Precision@K (hit rate in top-K) | NDCG@K (rank-aware quality)
Evaluates full pipeline with dynamic weights + MMR reranking
Run: .venv/bin/python scripts/run_evaluation.py | Also runs after nightly batch job (unless --skip-eval)
1. main.tsx calls initializeAuth() before React renders
2. Check localStorage for user email (session hint)
3. POST /auth/refresh (httpOnly cookie auto-sent) -> new access token in-memory
4. If refresh fails: clear all auth data, redirect to login
allowed_emails.py maps email domains to universities (e.g. @uwaterloo.ca)
POST /auth/forgot-password -> email link -> POST /auth/reset-password with token
ProtectedRoute component checks isAuthenticated() + isAdmin from AppContext
Views: Grid | Calendar | Map | Filters: category, school, price, date, food, registration, search, club type | AI filter generation (GPT-4o mini)
EventForm fields: title, description, location, date/time, category, organization, price, food, registration, image | Validation via Pydantic schema
Admin: manage events, clubs, submissions, reports, scraped events, posters, A/B metrics | All behind get_admin_user dependency
15+ PostgreSQL tables, all with RLS enabled, accessed via Supabase PostgREST SDK
Links to Supabase Auth via supabase_auth_id
RLS on every table, no permissive policies
users -(1:N)-> events (created_by) | users -(1:N)-> interactions | events -(1:N)-> interactions | users -(1:N)-> saved_events
users -(1:N)-> submissions | events -(1:N)-> reports | users -(1:1)-> credits | users -(1:N)-> promotions | clubs -(1:N)-> integrations
All tables: RLS enabled, no permissive policies. All access through backend service-role key. Frontend never touches DB directly.
